name: Winter Trip To a Cold Cabin
source:
"This was supposed to be a regular trip, like any other one you've ever taken."

On your way to your winter cabin you meet the cold face of death, meet him and re-live your past and go through the endings of the game to see where your story together goes.

A short yaoi visual novel about the cold and promises.

[From [url=https://rhoddonbyte.itch.io/winter-trip-to-a-cold-cabin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这应该是一次定期旅行，就像你曾经经历过的任何其他旅行一样。”

在前往冬季小屋的路上，你会遇到死亡的冷面，与他见面并重温你的过去，并浏览游戏的结局，看看你的故事将走向何方。

一部关于寒冷和承诺的短篇妖追视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://rhoddonbyte.itch.io/winter-trip-to-a-cold-cabin]itch.io[/url]]
